channel.title: OpenAI Engineering
channel.description: Engineering posts from the official OpenAI news feed

item.title: How we built a realtime system for responsive voice AI in six months
item.description: GPT-Live enables continuous voice interaction with AI, using a turnless speech model and low-latency architecture for faster, more natural conversations.

item.title: How GPT-5.6 fuses frontier intelligence with frontier efficiency
item.description: GPT-5.6 improves AI efficiency across models, inference, and agentic workflows, helping deliver more useful intelligence per dollar.

item.title: Core dump epidemiology: fixing an 18-year-old bug
item.description: OpenAI engineers used large-scale core dump analysis to debug rare infrastructure crashes, uncovering both a hardware fault and a long-standing software bug.

item.title: Building self-improving tax agents with Codex
item.description: See how OpenAI, Thrive, and Crete built a self-improving tax agent with Codex, automating filings, improving accuracy, and accelerating workflows.

item.title: Building a safe, effective sandbox to enable Codex on Windows
item.description: Learn how OpenAI built a safe, effective sandbox to enable Codex on Windows with controlled file access and network limits.

item.title: Unlocking large scale AI training networks with MRC (Multipath Reliable Connection)
item.description: OpenAI introduces MRC (Multipath Reliable Connection), a new supercomputer networking protocol released via OCP to improve resilience and performance in large-scale AI training clusters.

item.title: How OpenAI delivers low-latency voice AI at scale
item.description: How OpenAI rebuilt its WebRTC stack to power real-time Voice AI with low latency, global scale, and seamless conversational turn-taking.

item.title: An open-source spec for orchestration: Symphony
item.description: Learn how Symphony, an open-source spec for Codex orchestration, turns issue trackers into always-on agent systems—boosting engineering output and reducing context switching.

item.title: Speeding up agentic workflows with WebSockets in the Responses API
item.description: A deep dive into the Codex agent loop, showing how WebSockets and connection-scoped caching reduced API overhead and improved model latency.

item.title: From model to agent: Equipping the Responses API with a computer environment
item.description: How OpenAI built an agent runtime using the Responses API, shell tool, and hosted containers to run secure, scalable agents with files, tools, and state.

item.title: Beyond rate limits: scaling access to Codex and Sora
item.description: How OpenAI built a real-time access system combining rate limits, usage tracking, and credits to power continuous access to Sora and Codex.

item.title: Harness engineering: leveraging Codex in an agent-first world
item.description: By Ryan Lopopolo, Member of the Technical Staff

item.title: Unlocking the Codex harness: how we built the App Server
item.description: Learn how to embed the Codex agent using the Codex App Server, a bidirectional JSON-RPC API powering streaming progress, tool use, approvals, and diffs.

item.title: Inside OpenAI’s in-house data agent
item.description: How OpenAI built an in-house AI data agent that uses GPT-5, Codex, and memory to reason over massive datasets and deliver reliable insights in minutes.

item.title: Unrolling the Codex agent loop
item.description: A technical deep dive into the Codex agent loop, explaining how Codex CLI orchestrates models, tools, prompts, and performance using the Responses API.

item.title: Scaling PostgreSQL to power 800 million ChatGPT users
item.description: An inside look at how OpenAI scaled PostgreSQL to millions of queries per second using replicas, caching, rate limiting, and workload isolation.

item.description: OpenAI shipped Sora for Android in 28 days using Codex. AI-assisted planning, translation, and parallel coding workflows helped a nimble team deliver rapid, reliable development.

item.title: How we built OWL, the new architecture behind our ChatGPT-based browser, Atlas
item.description: A deep dive into OWL, the new architecture powering ChatGPT Atlas—decoupling Chromium, enabling fast startup, rich UI, and agentic browsing with ChatGPT.
